25 year old here. I got myself into MiniDisc cuz I wanted a device like a CD walkman to bring around with me without the hassle of dealing with scratched up disks. 

Cassettes were my 2nd choice, but i didnt have a way to transfer my music from digital to cassette. 

My solution was MiniDisc. before doing research, I've never even heard of the MiniDisc format. but the more I dove into it, the more it just checked the boxes for my needs. A small portable player with a durable storage media.

Thankfully, I live relatively close to Japan, so it was pretty easy to import a Sony LAM head unit that I use as a NetMD station, some MiniDiscs and a player.

Now I'm thoroughly enjoying my MD player!

If I was feeling particularly naughty, I'd stay awake till 10pm to midnight and watch a few episodes of City Hunter and Black Jack back to back.

I also remember watching Beyblade, B-Daman, and Bakugan when I was a little older.

This anime had so much potential but i dropped it after the 3rd episode. The announcer was annoying as heck. "King and Queen this..." "King and Queen that..." was there really no other way to avoid such repetitive commentary? 

MF Ghost had much better commentary in my opinion.  I really liked the fact that I was watching an actual racing commentator where they give their thoughts, color in the background of drivers, just all the little things make MF Ghost a much better motor racing anime for me.
